headline: The funnel converts and the first cash proves it. One account has carried the whole thing for eleven working days. That is the only number that matters.

sections.title: Bottleneck
sections.text: VOLUME, per causal order. 36 initials logged today against a 105 plan, 34 percent. MEASURED: every EOD note since Aug 12 says main account only, eleven consecutive working days, while doctrine records two accounts live from that date. No block language since Aug 10, so this is not account health, it is account count. Nothing downstream qualifies: booking ran 40 percent of this week's replies against a 35 percent floor, show was 3 of 4 calls sat, close 1 of 3.

sections.title: Levers in euros
sections.text: 1. Account 2 producing at 35 a day. Worth EUR 11,773 a month. Basis MEASURED funnel value of EUR 6.56 per initial (2.1% reply x 21.9% booking x 85.7% show x 33.3% close x EUR 5,000 deal), applied to the 1,794 initial gap over 26 days. Warm-up means this lands in September, not August. 2. The send split. Today ran 233 follow ups against 36 initials. MEASURED across 27 logged days: 7-day replies correlate +0.70 with initials at a four day lag and +0.08 with follow ups. HYPOTHESIS, needs a controlled week: moving 100 follow ups a day into 20 initials is worth EUR 3,412 a month and needs no warm-up. 3. The four unrecorded call outcomes. Worth EUR 5,000 to 10,000 in August alone at the measured 33 percent close, and it costs minutes. 4. The three Saturday replies. Worth EUR 937 expected on the measured conversion chain.

sections.title: Strategic moves
sections.text: Second setter: BLOCKED, all four gates fail. Reply 2.1 percent against a 3 percent gate, booking 21.9 percent all time against 35, volume not at plan for two weeks, queue not cleared daily at 17 untagged. More volume: the only permitted route is more warmed credible accounts, never pushing one harder, so account 2 warm-up is correct and is the plan. Account 3 ETA remains an OPEN QUESTION. New niche test: not assessable, the Replies tab carries no niche column. Reactivation: gate not met, the pool over four weeks old is roughly 158 initials from the Jul 25 to 27 cohort, under the 300 threshold.

sections.title: What you would miss
sections.text: Booking rate reads 21.9 percent and looks like a conversion failure. It is not. Three of this week's five replies landed Saturday night and have not been worked; on worked replies the week ran 40 percent. Show rate reads 85.7 percent, but Evan has no Showed mark on a call that already happened, so the true figure is unknown, not 85.7. Follow ups at 233 today are the lowest since Jul 28, the ladder draining as starved initials cohorts age out. It falls further before it recovers.

sections.title: Do not touch
sections.text: The message copy. The execution gate is not met at 34 percent of plan volume, so no copy verdict is permitted under the message-dead rules. Speed to lead, with three same-hour reply-to-book conversions measured. The pricing doctrine and the EUR 10k anchor. The 7.5 percent commission. The lead scheduler, parked by design.

sections.title: Training questions
sections.text: 1. Account 2: eleven working days of main account only since Aug 12, when doctrine records two accounts live from that date. Is it warming silently with zero sends, or has it not started, and what date does it first send? 2. The playbook has no rule for how Rhys splits his day between initials and follow ups. Today ran 6.5 to 1 after a week at 10.6 to 1. Given replies track initials and not follow ups in the measured data, what split do you want as standing policy?
